description: Instructions for breaking large tasks across multiple agentic runs instead of one response. Use when implementing a plan file, doing a large refactor, or any multi-phase task that won't fit in a single response. Covers the CONTINUE? Y or N and TASK COMPLETE! end-of-response markers, plus bash and CM
